hook:
Wade, then arrive.

Land Rover put a supercharged V8 in the Defender without giving up anything that makes it one.
body:
Supercharged V8, air suspension that lifts to 11.5 inches, and a wading depth that treats a flooded lane as a routing suggestion rather than an obstacle.

2024 Land Rover Defender 110 V8 — 518 hp · 461 lb-ft · 0–60 mph in 4.9 sec.

· 35.4 inches of wading depth — deeper than most cars are tall at the sill.
· Air suspension lifts ground clearance to 11.5 inches when the surface stops cooperating.
· 518 hp from a supercharged 5.0-litre V8, and 4.9 seconds to 60 mph.
· The party trick is not the speed. It is arriving dry, having taken the direct route.

The V8 sits alongside, rather than in place of, the vehicle’s off-road hardware.
cta: Ground clearance or wading depth — which number would you actually use?
